# TerraCorridor · all workflows on one canvas (SHOWCASE ONLY)
**Do not publish or execute this workflow.** Credentials and Data Table IDs belong to the live instance, so a run here fails at the first table read. The live system runs as separate workflows that share 11 Data Tables (see workflows/README.md). Webhook paths here are prefixed `showcase/` so they never clash.

**How they connect**
W1 Corridor Setup → (Execute Workflow) → W2 Long-Range Engine → corridor_predictions / corridor_baselines
WF3 Near-term watch (daily 06:00) reads predictions → (Execute Workflow) → WF4 Work orders (AI summary, human approval, audit)
W5 Build Layer + weekly report (Mon) reads segments, predictions, work orders
API Dashboard feed serves GET /webhook/terracorridor/corridor; WF4 takes POST /webhook/terracorridor/action

**AI explains. Rules decide. People approve.**
